text.description_html:
RK International CK-305, Black Porcelain Knob with Polished Brass Base

With the glamourous fashions of the 1920's coming back in style, the Black Porcelain Ball Cabinet Knob with Polished Brass Rose really brings out the best of retro decor. There is something so stunning about the shiny black porcelain offset by the glittering gold of the brass rose. This cabinet knob is available with either a 1 inch diameter or a 1-1/4 inch diameter.

Also Available Matching: Black Porcelain Ball Cabinet Knob with Polished Chrome Rose

Specifications and Features of the RK International CK-305 Porcelain Knob:

  • Material: porcelain with some brass
  • Porcelain Color: Black
  • Base Finish: Polished Brass
  • Screw: 1" long #8 - 32 machine screw.
  • Packaged with all necessary installation hardware.

Available in 2 Sizes

    RKI-CK-305:
    • Diameter: 1"
    • Projection: 1-3/8"

    RKI-CK-301:
    • Diameter: 1-1/4"
    • Projection: 1-5/8"

Sold Individually
